name: AIMFLEX
recent: Aimflex 在 2026 年 11 月连续进行股份回购，并披露执行主席 Chuah Chong Ewe 在闭市期内的交易意向。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收与净利均录得环比及同比增长。
notable: 2026 年 11 月多次进行股份回购。
执行主席 Chuah Chong Ewe 披露在闭市期内交易公司股份的意向。
risks: 执行主席在闭市期内有交易意向，需留意后续股权变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 21.134 million，环比增长 9.9%，同比增长 29.2%；净利为 MYR 4.107 million，环比增长 41.7%，同比增长 88.0%；净利率为 19.4%，高于上一季度的 15.1%。

recent_en: Revenue and net profit for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose both quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year.
notable_en: Executive Chairman Chuah Chong Ewe disclosed intention to deal in the company's shares during the closed period.
risks_en: The Executive Chairman's intention to deal during the closed period warrants attention to subsequent shareholding changes.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 21.134 million, up 9.9% QoQ and 29.2% YoY; net profit was MYR 4.107 million, up 41.7% QoQ and 88.0% YoY; net margin was 19.4%, higher than 15.1% in the previous quarter.
